question: Simplify: ((1)/(7+sqrt{2)}) + ((1)/(7-sqrt{2)}) - ((14)/(49-2))
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Combine the first two fractional terms directly by cross-multiplying their denominators. Sum = [(7 − √2) + (7 + √2)] ÷ [(7 + √2) × (7 − √2)] Sum = 14 ÷ (49 − 2) Notice that the third term is exactly identical to this sum. Expression = [14 ÷ (49 − 2)] − [14 ÷ (49 − 2)] = 0 **∴ The correct answer is 0.**
